helpIntro: UCF uses a 4.0 plus/minus scale. Enter UCF semester hours and posted grades to estimate your current or projected undergraduate UCF GPA.
helpNote: S/U and NC do not affect GPA; F and WF count at zero. Transfer, graduate, program and financial-aid GPAs can use different populations. Repeat Impact is only an estimate for an approved UCF Grade Forgiveness case.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12 grade points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.75; together, 21.75 ÷ 6 = 3.625.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.75 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.25 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.75 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.25 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.75 grade points per semester hour; C- or lower can be eligible as the original grade for UCF Grade Forgiveness.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.25 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.00 grade point per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.75 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.00 grade points and its attempted hours count in GPA.
gradeExplanations.WF: WF is calculated as a failing grade in GPA.
gradeExplanations.S: S earns credit under S/U grading but does not affect GPA.
gradeExplanations.U: U earns no credit under S/U grading and does not affect GPA.
gradeExplanations.NC: NC does not affect GPA; it is available only in designated courses.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is not a final GPA grade; unresolved I normally changes to F after the deadline.
gradeExplanations.N: N means no grade reported; wait for a final grade before calculating.

specialTypes.name: UCF course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: Use posted UCF grades. S/U, NC, W/WP and temporary grades are excluded as listed; WF/F count at zero.

specialTypes.name: Transfer, transient, or other external coursework
specialTypes.note: Do not mix external grades into this UCF-GPA estimate. Transfer/admission and financial-aid calculations can use different populations.

repeatPolicy.note: Use Repeat Impact only to estimate an approved UCF Grade Forgiveness case: the second final grade substitutes for the eligible original grade even if it is lower.
